original_test_intent: Stage the approved baseboard firmware through the confirmed Vulcan BMC Redfish target, activate it with one authorized AC power cycle, and prove that every intended component reports its approved new version with a healthy recovered platform.
original_method: Record complete pre-update inventory and health; map every claimed baseboard component to an exact Redfish inventory/target; verify signed bundle compatibility and rollback; upload once through authenticated TLS, retain returned task URI and terminal messages; require operator AC-cycle approval; re-enumerate all components, host/GPU/PCIe and management health; preserve failure and recovery evidence.
manual_activity: Engineer maps the intended component set and approves bundle/activation/recovery; operator owns maintenance and AC power; agent may perform only the approved upload, task observation and readback.
required_inputs: Authoritative list of all in-scope baseboard components and Redfish target mapping
Signed immutable bundle/hash, current/target versions and platform compatibility/dependency manifest
Verified BMC/SUT/HGX identity, certificate/credential handling and UpdateService semantics
Backup, rollback or redundant-image recovery plus console/PDU access
Maintenance/job drain, power redundancy and explicit flash/AC-cycle approvals
safety_requirements: Never upload before component, image and target identities match
Do not copy default credentials, disable TLS verification or assume task ID 1
Do not AC-cycle until upload is terminal and activation semantics are confirmed
Stop on task target/status mismatch, management loss, power fault or unexpected inventory
No retry or second image without preserved evidence and fresh engineer approval
agent_execution_scope: Validate read-only inventory, image and target gates
After approvals upload once and follow returned task URI
Collect pre/post per-component versions and platform health
Coordinate cleanup/recovery and report without verdict
engineer_actions: Resolve scope/target conflict and approve image, versions, compatibility and rollback
Authorize flash, maintenance and AC cycle; own recovery

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Generic nvflash/nvsm does not implement the source's Vulcan Redfish upload, returned task and all-component inventory coverage.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use the vendor-approved authenticated Redfish workflow with a generated parameter document for the exact mapped targets, monitor the returned task resource, then perform one operator-controlled AC activation and full inventory readback.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: HGX_0 and thirty-minute machine estimate are preserved as source data, not assumed to cover every baseboard component.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Create a before/after component matrix keyed by immutable Redfish IDs and image manifest; bind upload response, task transitions and AC event to that matrix.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Eliminates literal credentials, insecure TLS and fixed task ID while proving every claimed target rather than one aggregate version.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: One HGX_0 task cannot prove all baseboard components were staged or activated unless vendor mapping explicitly says so.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A terminal upload task may mean staged rather than active; post-AC active-version readback and health are mandatory.

project_override_considerations: Firmware owner supplies the SKU-specific component-to-HGX_0 mapping, activation bank behavior and supported recovery path.
expected_evidence: SUT/BMC identity and signed bundle/hash/compatibility manifest
Pre/post complete FirmwareInventory with per-component active/staged versions
Exact Redfish targets, sanitized request, returned task URI and full terminal messages
Operator AC-cycle/PDU/console timestamps and management/host recovery

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Compatibility row262 Wistron-NV GPU-00255-V002: define the authoritative 'all baseboard components' set and map it to the single HGX_0 target/DGX wording; approve exact signed bundle, per-component current/target/active-bank versions, dependencies, Redfish activation semantics, rollback and AC-cycle/OOB recovery contract.

review_improvement: Turns an aggregate flash step into component-complete, task-traceable activation evidence with explicit rollback and recovery gates.
independent_technical_reasoning: Firmware upload success is not activation success: UpdateService can stage an image while active inventory remains unchanged until power removal. A logical HGX_0 target may fan out to several devices, but that mapping is platform-specific and cannot be inferred from the title. Correctness therefore requires per-component before/after active versions and post-cycle management/host health, not only a Completed task string.
